# Independent review of H-Earth startup scheduling repair

Reviewer: independent native review agent `/root/independent_review`, 2026-10-04 UTC. Read-only review; no application edits, commits, browser reruns, or physical-device testing performed.

Frozen application candidate: `a40a267b0100c30d2760f47106444029aecee367`.
Accepted comparison baseline: `57b2ee71f3018b1ca5fe486f301aae7371ff54a5`.

## Conclusion

PASS for the saved startup, completion, touch-control and application-preservation evidence. Publication remains conditional on all selected exact-final-candidate checks and live deployment verification. This review is not publication authorization or physical-device acceptance.

Read root AGENTS.md, AI_ENTRYPOINT.json, H-Earth showroom AGENTS.md, the experience anchor and its visual proxy. Independently inspected candidate source, saved matrix, verifier and browser adapter. Checkout HEAD was the frozen candidate and tracked working tree was clean. The verifier requires exact HEAD and a clean tracked checkout before serving that checkout; each of the three completed receipts binds the full frozen candidate. Browser adapter only supplies the Chromium executable, SwiftShader launch flags, and library/font environment; no application shim.

## Saved execution results

All three completed receipts report PASS, empty page/console runtime-error arrays and empty failed-request arrays. All show validated complete residency, exactly 27,585 instances, 108 batches, zero drops, zero world rebuilds, camera independence, and the qualified manifest digest `9055c817cac9db1de48f1b7ee814bfda954255429564e44e7a664dab66616b4e`.

Times below are milliseconds on the recorded browser performance clock, not physical-device benchmarks.

| Profile | First frame | READY | Preparation starts | Preparation ends | Loading starts | Loading complete | Input enabled |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Desktop, 1280 × 800, CPU 1× | 50629.5 | 50640.4 | 50641.6 | 112740.2 | 112749.4 | 180707.6 | 51087.8 |
| Constrained mobile emulation, 390 × 844, CPU 4× | 120037.8 | 120071.4 | 120078.8 | 297029.4 | 297053.6 | 514065.9 | 120540.6 |
| Mobile landscape emulation, 844 × 390, CPU 1× | 52343.7 | 52356.8 | 52357.8 | 119991.9 | 120011.5 | 177369.7 | 52815.4 |

I independently checked `firstFrame < ready < preparationStart < preparationComplete < vegetationStart < vegetationComplete` for each receipt. The verifier asserts first-frame/readiness/loading order but does not itself assert the preparation ordering; saved numeric evidence fills that review gap without an application change. READY snapshots show zero resident instances and batches and preparation still pending. Input becomes available shortly after readiness while foliage preparation/loading continues.

Both mobile profiles use Chromium touch emulation and SwiftShader. They are explicitly emulation, not phone/tablet physical-device runs. Long emulated timings do not support a physical-device speedup claim.

## Controls

Reviewed actual verifier assertions, not only PASS labels. Two-finger travel requires movement in the camera-relative requested direction, opposite forward/backward displacement, and no motion after release. One-finger look requires yaw change and no yaw change after release. Cancellation requires actual preceding travel, native pointer-cancel count increase, and stopped position after cancellation.

Constrained mobile: forward z −5.3880476467, backward z +4.0500004171; look yaw 0 → 17.2800023129 degrees then unchanged; two pointer cancellations and equal cancelled/stopped positions.
Landscape: forward z −2.8795679951, backward z +3.3481438588; look yaw 0 → 11.5049855080 degrees then unchanged; two pointer cancellations and equal cancelled/stopped positions.

The early `*-ready.json` snapshots retain the verifier initial FAIL field because they are saved before completion, without a failure assertion. They must be preserved as interim snapshots, not described as failed completed runs or substituted for final receipts.

## Preservation

Independently compared baseline57b2-equivalence.json with candidate67cf-equivalence.json: grounded-plan object/digest, base-package buffers/spans/ranges/identifiers, every one of 108 presentation batch records, and aggregate presentation digest are identical. The asynchronous oasis receipt additionally proves the first prepared batch matches the baseline hash with 350 grass tufts, 72 cattails and 494 primitives.

Independently compared git objects for 67cfbc240e8f76d22e2eb860485de6f625f574f4 → a40a: all changed application files and publication-surface data become exactly equal when only cache query parameters are removed. The separate verifier delta adds landscape, input readiness and normalized gesture checks. Thus the existing data equivalence carries to a40a. Full baseline→candidate changed-path list contains no control-intake/navigation implementation, terrain-field, grass/cattail morphology, placement manifest, camera authority or accepted-material source changes. Scheduling and diagnostic changes intentionally alter when preparation executes, not the resulting environment.

## Experience anchor assessment

Viewed the repository anchor proxy and saved desktop candidate screenshot. Both show embodied ground-level terrain and horizon; the candidate preserves navigable terrain/water world with limited overlay controls rather than a dashboard/card/map substitution. Tested look/travel evidence supports the direct-interaction invariant. The baseline-equivalent world/package and unchanged navigation/representation implementations support preservation of existing global-continuity invariants as a scheduling-only delta.

An evidence-only anchor acceptance receipt is supportable if it names these exact candidate screenshots/receipts, binds changed experience-file hashes, distinguishes newly observed local-world behavior from inherited unchanged planetary/regional continuity, and records physicalAcceptancePerformed=false. No globe-to-region transition or original-video physical-device replay was newly executed in this review. Existing historical first-frame correspondence anchor receipt was inspected; it cannot by itself establish all current candidate file identities.

## Publication boundary

Parent reported selected Experience Anchor Gate failure 37168745705, EXPERIENCE_CHANGE_WITHOUT_ANCHOR_RECEIPT, and Registry Preflight failure 37168745655, REQUESTED_PATH_UNRESOLVED. These results must be preserved and diagnosed. This review supports a truthful evidence-only anchor receipt, not ignoring either failed required check. Any final evidence commit must prove tested application blobs unchanged from a40a and run required publication checks against its final exact head. Merge, deployment, and live exact-commit verification are outside this independent review and remain required.

## Follow-up registry diagnosis and receipt correction

Read `tools/h-earth-experience-anchor-gate.mjs` filtering directly. Its definition excludes diagnostic files. The prepared anchor receipt now binds exactly 11 changed experience files under that definition, not the broader initial 13-file protected-path set. Diagnostic preservation remains part of source review, not the gate receipt experience-file set.

Read `.github/ai-router/page-mutation-proportionality-policy.v1.json#candidateScopeRecognition` directly: an exact admitted allowed path is recognized for that operation without separate persistent registration, even when candidate-created. It cannot expand scope or waive qualification. Parent's recovered original admission identifies the four unresolved paths as literal allowed paths: `showroom/globe/h-earth/diagnostic/renderer-startup-observer.v1.js`, `showroom/globe/h-earth/functional-landscape/public-live-gpu-integration.run8e-r3e.receipt.js`, `showroom/globe/h-earth/render/gpu-upload-views.run8e-r2d.js`, and `showroom/globe/h-earth/render/live-render-package.run8e-r2.js`. These are existing files, not a new authority/workflow/publication boundary. Subject to retaining that authentic literal admission evidence, the unresolved-path failure diagnoses a registry recognition mismatch, not an unauthorized scope expansion. The evidence record must retain the original failed check and the policy-based disposition; this review does not claim the failed workflow turned green or authorize any control-plane mutation. The exact admitted report path can likewise use this operation-scoped recognition without inventing durable prefix ownership.

The worker entry is the existing `geometry-grounded-vegetation.run8d.js`, not a newly created worker path; no scope expansion follows from its worker use.

Direct admission cross-check completed: independently read the recovered issue comment 5970456165 in admission-source.json and compared its constructionProcedure.exactAllowedRepositoryPaths with all 15 baseline-to-a40a changed paths. All 15 are literal members, including all four registry-unresolved paths. All three proposed evidence destinations are also literal members. This resolves the prior conditional dependence on parent-reported scope; no new scope or persistent registration is needed. The admission independently limits extra physical review to material uncertainty not resolvable through engineering verification.
